subject: mathematics
concept: Converting between meters and centimeters (1 m = 100 cm)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student lines up 100 virtual 1cm blocks against a 1m strip to see the equivalence
exercise.pictorial: Student matches measurements shown in cm to their equivalent in m (and vice versa)
exercise.abstract: Student converts simple whole-number values between cm and m

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
